summary: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment to add twelve at-large Senators elected by national popular vote and twelve at-large presidential electors who would cast their votes for the national popular vote winners.

scores.thoughts: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment to create national popular vote elections for twelve at-large Senators and for twelve at-large Electors for President and Vice-President. This fundamentally changes how these federal offices are elected, expanding the concept of national popular vote and thus significantly impacting voting and election processes at a federal level.
